name: ConfPass
description: ConfPass password manager — autofill and secure access
author: emreconf

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'; connect-src https://pass.conftag.pro http://127.0.0.1:49201; img-src 'self' data: https://icons.duckduckgo.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com;
